name: NESS-0327
summary: NESS-0327 is a drug used in scientific research which acts as an extremely potent and selective antagonist of the cannabinoid receptor CB1.e.00035nM) and a selectivity of over 60,000x for CB1 over CB2.

pharmacology.text: NESS-0327 is a drug used in scientific research which acts as an extremely potent and selective antagonist of the cannabinoid receptor CB1. It is much more potent an antagonist, and more selective for the CB1 receptor over CB2, than the more commonly used ligand rimonabant, with a Ki at CB1 of 350fM (i.e. 0.00035nM) and a selectivity of over 60,000x for CB1 over CB2.

fact.en: NESS-0327 is one of the most powerful CB1 blockers ever made, with a reported preference for CB1 over CB2 of more than sixty thousand fold.
